name: io.github.lamtoueqali-eng/darija-mcp
title: Darija & Arabic Dialects MCP
description: Spoken Arabic for AI agents: dialects, sentiment, Arabizi, names, Tamazight Tifinagh.

tools.name: detect_darija
tools.description:
FREE. Detects whether a text is Moroccan Darija (Arabic script or Arabizi/Latin) and returns a confidence score, the script used and the Darija markers found.

Pricing: free, no API key needed.

tools.name: detect_arabic_dialect
tools.description:
FREE. Guesses which spoken Arabic dialect a text is written in (Moroccan, Algerian, Tunisian, Libyan, Egyptian, Sudanese, Levantine, Iraqi, Gulf, Yemeni), in Arabic script or Arabizi. Use it to pick the right "dialect" for the translation tools.

Pricing: free, no API key needed.

tools.name: translate_from_darija
tools.description:
Translates spoken Arabic dialect text (Moroccan Darija by default, or Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf, etc.) in Arabic script, Arabizi or mixed with French/English, into English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Turkish or Modern Standard Arabic. Handles slang and code-switching better than generic translators.

Pricing: $0.02 per successful call. Free daily trial without an API key; unlimited with a plan key, or pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/darija-mcp (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

dialect.description: Arabic dialect. Default: darija (Moroccan). Darija is native-reviewed; other dialects are in beta.

tools.name: translate_to_darija
tools.description:
Translates English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Turkish or Standard Arabic text into a natural spoken Arabic dialect, as natives really write it: Moroccan Darija by default, or Egyptian, Levantine, Gulf, Iraqi, Algerian, Tunisian and more. Arabic script, Arabizi (Latin) or both; casual, polite or business tone. Ideal for customer messages, marketing and chatbots in Arab markets.

Pricing: $0.02 per successful call. Free daily trial without an API key; unlimited with a plan key, or pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/darija-mcp (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

dialect.description: Arabic dialect. Default: darija (Moroccan). Darija is native-reviewed; other dialects are in beta.

script.description: "latin" = Arabizi as used on WhatsApp and social media. Default: arabic.

tools.name: arabizi_to_arabic
tools.description:
Converts Arabic dialect text written in Latin letters with digits (Arabizi / Franco-Arabic, e.g. "wach nta mzyan? 3afak" or "ezayak 3amel eh") into Arabic script, without translating it. Useful to clean social media, WhatsApp or customer-support data before analysis.

Pricing: $0.02 per successful call. Free daily trial without an API key; unlimited with a plan key, or pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/darija-mcp (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

dialect.description: Dialect of the text, if known. Default: darija.

tools.name: arabic_name_variants
tools.description:
Given a person or family name of Arabic origin (in Arabic script or Latin letters), returns its Arabic spelling and the common Latin spelling variants used across countries (e.g. Mohammed / Muhammad / Mohamed / Mohamad), plus particle variants (Al-, El-, bin, ben, Abd, Abdel...). Use it to search records, deduplicate CRMs or broaden lookups. It is a search aid, not an identity or compliance decision.

Pricing: $0.02 per successful call. Free daily trial without an API key; unlimited with a plan key, or pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/darija-mcp (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

max_variants.description: Max Latin variants per name part. Default: 10.

tools.name: tifinagh_transliterate
tools.description:
FREE and instant. Transliterates Tamazight (Amazigh/Berber) between Latin script and Tifinagh (Neo-Tifinagh, IRCAM standard), e.g. "tamaziɣt" or "tamazight" ↔ ⵜⴰⵎⴰⵣⵉⵖⵜ. Direction is detected automatically. Accepts IRCAM spelling (ḍ ṣ ṭ ẓ ṛ ḥ ɛ ɣ) and common web spellings (gh, kh, ch, 3, 7). Letter-level transliteration, not translation.

Pricing: free, no API key needed.

text.description: Text in Latin or Tifinagh script (max 4000 characters).

emphatic_uppercase.description: Treat uppercase D, S, T, Z, R, H as emphatic consonants (ḍ, ṣ, ṭ, ẓ, ṛ, ḥ). Default: false.

tools.name: analyze_sentiment
tools.description:
Sentiment and opinion analysis for customer reviews, messages and social media posts written in spoken Arabic dialects (Moroccan Darija, Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine and others), in Arabic script, Arabizi or mixed with French/English. Returns overall sentiment, a score from -1 to 1, the aspects mentioned (price, delivery, quality, service...) with their sentiment, the detected dialect and a one-line English summary. Built for review monitoring, social listening and customer support triage.

Pricing: $0.02 per successful call. Free daily trial without an API key; unlimited with a plan key, or pay per call autonomously through the Apify Actor ali-lamtoueq/darija-mcp (x402/MPP/Skyfire).

dialect.description: Dialect of the text, if known. Default: auto-detect.
